services_heading: Complete Tree Surgery Services Across Leeds

services.title: Emergency Tree Removal
services.desc: Storm damage or fallen trees threatening your property? We respond fast with full debris clearance and site reinstatement. Call anytime for urgent callouts.

services.title: Tree Felling & Stump Grinding
services.desc: Safe, controlled felling of dead or diseased trees. We grind stumps flush with the ground, so you can reclaim your garden space completely.

services.title: Crown Reduction & Pruning
services.desc: Reduce the height and spread of overgrown trees to restore views and improve light, without harming the tree's health or structure.

services.title: Deadwood Removal
services.desc: Dangerous dead branches removed safely from living trees. Protects your property and helps the tree thrive by removing disease vectors.

services.title: Hedge Trimming & Maintenance
services.desc: Regular hedge cutting keeps boundaries neat and encourages dense, healthy growth. We handle everything from garden screens to formal boundaries.

services.title: Tree Health Assessment
services.desc: Professional inspection identifies disease, structural weakness, and pest damage early. We advise on treatment or safe removal before problems escalate.

about_pullquote: We treat every tree like it's been in your family for generations.
about_para_1: LDT Tree Services started in Leeds over a decade ago with a simple goal: bring professional, honest arborist work to homeowners tired of cowboys and overpricing. We're NPTC-qualified, fully insured, and carry every specialist tool needed for safe, efficient work. Whether you need emergency storm response or routine garden maintenance, we've built our reputation on turning up on time, doing the job right, and leaving your garden spotless.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we listen first. We walk your garden, explain what needs doing and why, and never push work you don't need. We're locals who care about the neighbourhood — your tree's health matters to us as much as the job getting done quickly. With over 2,000 trees managed and counting, we've earned the trust of families and businesses right across Leeds.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About LDT

reviews.text: Had a massive oak leaning over the garage after the storm. LDT were here within two hours of my call. They felled it safely, chipped all the wood, and left the garden cleaner than they found it. Honest price, no messing about. Can't fault them.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Our sycamore had dead branches hanging directly over the kids' play area. I was worried but the crew explained everything they were doing. Very professional, very safe. Cleaned up every twig. They even advised us on keeping the tree healthy long-term. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: Jennifer P.

reviews.text: Been using LDT for three years now — they come every autumn to tidy the hedges and trim the fruit trees. Always on time, always friendly, and the price never creeps up. The garden looks fantastic. Would recommend to anyone.
reviews.author: Robert K.
